title: ID0455311-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002445] Isolation dropped - Jaguar iPace 2019
description:
Reported behavior/issue -
Check logs
Solution:
Please update the vehicle to the latest FW available. This fault is relevant for outdated FW versions and it has been acknowledged by Jaguar; it is consistent for pre-2021 Jaguar iPace models. Siemens and Jaguar are currently working together to solve these issues permanently.
In the meantime, we would recommend to let Jaguar update your vehicle with the newest version available.

additional_info.subject: ID0455311-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002445] Check logs CRM:03056000164
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
After our investigation, we found that the error is related to the vehicle that was trying to charge during the time slot you mentioned. The issue appears to come from the vehicle side and caused a problem with our isolation measurement device.
Additionally, after a second check—as you can see in the screenshot I sent—many other charging sessions with different vehicles worked perfectly. If you can try another charging session with the same vehicle that caused the issue, we might be able to identify a more specific solution.
We will also monitor this charger during upcoming sessions to understand if the issue is related to other EVs.
Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0455311-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002445] Check logs CRM:03056000164
additional_info.body:
Hi Filomena, good morning.
This is a known issue for the Jaguar iPace models from pre-2021. Here is our statement related to this particular problem.
Please update the vehicle to the latest FW available. This fault is relevant for outdated FW versions and it has been acknowledged by Jaguar; it is consistent for pre-2021 Jaguar iPace models. Siemens and Jaguar are currently working together to solve these issues permanently.
In the meantime, we would recommend to let Jaguar update your vehicle with the newest version available.
Since the answer has been provided and the problem is not related to the charger, as we can see from the multiple successfull sessions, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
